Definition: from G2443 and G5101; for what reason?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.
BiblicalUsage: The word hinatí is wherefore, why — a small word, used 6 times; Matthew and Luke show it in use.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hinatí means wherefore, why, and I do not stretch it further.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Paralytic; The Parable of the Barren Fig Tree
